title: Period and Shifted Graph of y = sin(x - pi/4) + 1
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the fundamental period of y = \sin(x - \pi/4) + 1 and describe the horizontal and vertical shifts that transform y = \sin x into its graph.

steps.title: Find the Period
steps.explanation: Since x has coefficient 1, the period of the function is B = 2*pi.
steps.why: Neither horizontal nor vertical translations affect the period of a sinusoid.

steps.title: Identify Horizontal and Vertical Shifts and Range
steps.explanation: The graph of y = sin x is shifted right by pi/4 units and upward by 1 unit, oscillating about the midline y = 1 between y = 0 and y = 2.
steps.why: In A*sin((2*pi/B)*(x - C)) + D, C is the horizontal shift and D is the vertical midline shift.

steps.title: List Key Quarter-Period Landmarks on [pi/4, 9*pi/4]
steps.explanation: Shift the x-coordinates 0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2, 2*pi right by pi/4 and add 1 to each corresponding sine value.
steps.why: Applying (x, y) -> (x + pi/4, y + 1) maps the fundamental cycle of sin x onto the shifted curve.
